summary: The convention worker responsible for finding people gets a call about someone who never checked in.
realLife: Vogelsinger recalled losing track of colleagues while serving as the Kennedy convention locator.
gates: The campaign has designated a contact desk.
inGame: needs: convention check-in times, a contact desk and an outstanding request to find someone.

turns.what: The desk gives the caller the room from the latest check-in.
turns.pulledBy: The candidate told the worker where the next meeting would be.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry closes at the desk.

turns.what: The candidate checks in after the caller has left.
turns.pulledBy: A meeting ran longer than the desk expected.
turns.writesBack: The worker logs the new location and a return call.
